faqs.question: What are the requirements for barangay clearance?
faqs.answer: To get a Barangay Clearance, you need: 1) Valid ID (Government-issued), 2) Community Tax Certificate (Cedula), 3) Proof of residency (Utility bill or lease agreement), 4) Payment of ₱50 processing fee. Processing takes 1-2 business days.

faqs.question: How long is barangay clearance valid?
faqs.answer: Barangay Clearance is valid for 365 days (1 year) from the date of issuance. You should renew it before expiration to avoid penalties or complications with other government transactions.

faqs.question: What is barangay clearance used for?
faqs.answer: Barangay Clearance is required for: Job applications, Business permits, Passport applications, Loan applications, SSS/GSIS transactions, School enrollment, and other government services requiring proof of good standing.

faqs.question: What do I need for barangay residency certificate?
faqs.answer: For Barangay Residency Certificate, you need: 1) Valid ID, 2) Proof of residency (3 months minimum), 3) ₱30 processing fee. This confirms your length of stay in the barangay.

faqs.question: How to get barangay indigency certificate?
faqs.answer: Barangay Indigency Certificate is FREE for low-income residents. Requirements: 1) Valid ID, 2) Proof of income (below poverty line), 3) Barangay assessment. Used for medical assistance, scholarships, and social services.

faqs.question: What are the requirements for barangay business permit?
faqs.answer: For Business Permit, you need: 1) DTI/SEC Registration, 2) Mayor's Permit, 3) Barangay Clearance, 4) Location photos, 5) ₱100 processing fee. Required for legitimate business operations.

faqs.question: How long does it take to process certificates?
faqs.answer: Processing times: Barangay Clearance (1-2 days), Residency Certificate (same day), Indigency Certificate (1-3 days), Business Permit (3-5 days). Rush processing available for additional fees.

faqs.question: How do I report an incident to the barangay?
faqs.answer: To report an incident: 1) Visit barangay hall during office hours, 2) Fill out blotter report form, 3) Provide witness information if available, 4) Barangay will investigate and mediate. All reports are confidential.

faqs.question: What happens after I file a blotter report?
faqs.answer: After filing: 1) Barangay assigns case number, 2) Initial investigation within 3 days, 3) Mediation session scheduled, 4) Resolution or escalation to higher authorities. Most cases resolved through mediation.

faqs.question: How do I get a barangay ID?
faqs.answer: For Barangay ID: 1) Must be registered resident (6 months+), 2) Bring 2x2 photo, 3) Valid ID for verification, 4) ₱20 processing fee. IDs are valid for 3 years and required for many local services.

faqs.question: What are the barangay office hours?
faqs.answer: Office Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM. Closed on Sundays and holidays. Emergency services available 24/7 through barangay tanod hotlines.

faqs.question: How can I contact the barangay?
faqs.answer: Contact Information: Phone (02) 123-4567, Email: barangay@batia.gov.ph, Facebook: Barangay Batia Official. Emergency Hotline: 0917-123-4567. Located at Barangay Hall, Poblacion, Batia.

faqs.question: What to do if I lost my barangay documents?
faqs.answer: For lost documents: 1) File affidavit of loss, 2) Provide valid ID, 3) Pay ₱25 processing fee, 4) New document issued within 3-5 days. Always keep photocopies of important documents.

faqs.question: What benefits do senior citizens get from barangay?
faqs.answer: Senior Citizen Benefits: 20% discount on medicines, Free medical check-ups, Priority service lines, Exemption from some fees, Monthly stipend assistance, Transportation subsidies, and special programs for active seniors.

faqs.question: What assistance is available for PWDs?
faqs.answer: PWD Assistance: Medical assistance, Mobility aid subsidies, Home modification grants, Job placement services, Educational scholarships, Transportation discounts, and special parking privileges.

faqs.question: What help is available for single parents?
faqs.answer: Single Parent Support: Financial assistance programs, Child care subsidies, Educational grants for children, Counseling services, Job training programs, Legal assistance, and emergency relief funds.

faqs.question: What community events does the barangay organize?
faqs.answer: Community Events: Monthly health seminars, Clean-up drives, Sports tournaments, Cultural festivals, Senior citizen programs, Youth leadership camps, Disaster preparedness drills, and regular barangay assemblies.

faqs.question: What emergency services does the barangay provide?
faqs.answer: Emergency Services: 24/7 barangay tanod patrol, Fire response coordination, Medical emergencies, Lost children assistance, Vehicle towing, Flood evacuation, and coordination with police/fire departments.

faqs.question: How does waste disposal work in the barangay?
faqs.answer: Waste Disposal: Monday-Wednesday-Friday collection schedule, Segregate biodegradable and non-biodegradable waste, ₱50 quarterly fee, Special collection for bulky items, Eco-friendly disposal programs available.
